records.text: People magazine reported that Lori Frantzve divorced Erika Kirk's father after Erika's birth and raised Erika as a single mother in Scottsdale, Arizona.
records.speaker: People magazine

appearances.snippet: Erika Kirk has learned a lot from her mother, Lori Frantzve. ... After welcoming her daughter in November of 1988, ... Frantzve divorced Erica (Erika Kirk)'s father, ... Kent Frantzve, ... and raised her as a single mother in Scottsdale, Arizona.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (People magazine quoted article). A current accessible republication of the People article contains the same report: after Erika's November 1988 birth, Lori divorced Kent and raised Erika as a single mother in Scottsdale. This verifies what the cited article reported, regardless of later disputes about the underlying family history.

sources.title: What to Know About Erika Kirk's Mom, Lori Frantzve
sources.relevance: Accessible republication of the People article containing the quoted single-mother report.
